effects.name: Polarization
effects.function: filter light by orientation and reveal stress fields
effects.statement: Polarizers select components of light polarization; in suitable transparent materials, stress-induced birefringence changes relative optical phase and reveals stress patterns.
limitations: Stress analysis requires a suitable material and calibrated optical arrangement; polarization is not simply rotated by all transparent materials.
Only the analyzer transmission clause is typed; stress-induced birefringence and photoelastic inference require additional quantities and a material model.

relative angle measured between incident polarization and analyzer axis

model_assessment.rationale: Analyzer transmission and stress-induced optical retardance have different inputs and outputs. Keep the current analyzer clause; give photoelasticity its own sourced model before composing a stress sensor.

effects.name: Superconductivity
effects.function: carry direct current with zero electrical resistance within a superconducting operating range
effects.statement: Suitable materials have zero DC electrical resistance below material-dependent critical limits and exhibit superconducting magnetic behavior.
conditions: specified superconducting material and circuit path
temperature, magnetic field and current remain within critical limits
cooling and terminal conditions supplied separately
limitations: Zero DC resistance does not mean a lossless complete system; cooling and time-varying operation can incur losses.
A transmission generator is not the categorical identity. DC zero resistance does not establish zero system energy, zero AC loss or feasibility without cooling.

provenance.citation: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-2/pages/9-6-superconductors ; repository-authored selected clause and quantity declarations

effects.source: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-2/pages/9-6-superconductors ; repository-selected clause: Input current to transmitted current through a selected superconducting DC path.

model_assessment.selected_clause: DC current transmission inside the declared superconducting envelope.
model_assessment.rationale: Transport and magnetic response are different observable contracts of a shared material phase. Keep their common state model; zero DC resistance alone does not provide a Meissner or levitation contract.

effects.name: Electrostatic repulsion
effects.function: release particles from a surface or keep them off it with like charges
effects.statement: Like charges repel; with a suitable charge distribution, electrostatic forces can lift particles when they exceed opposing adhesion and other forces.
hints: electrostatic dust detachment under controlled charging
limitations: Repulsion must overcome adhesion and other forces; traveling-field electrodynamic screens also use field gradients and are a separate mechanism.
